# Pattern index

5 patterns. Read this first, pick 2 or 3, then open only the chosen pattern files.

- **3D tilt hover** `3d-tilt-hover` (motion). Use when: One hero element should feel physical. Avoid when: Every card on a page, or touch screens without drag. Mood: playful, techy. Sections: hero. Cost: light, mobile risk low. Pairs with: orbit-animation. File: `patterns/3d-tilt-hover/pattern.md`
- **Orbit animation** `orbit-animation` (motion). Use when: One hero visual should show a set of things (a stack, integrations) as one system. Avoid when: Next to other moving things, or as a loading indicator (a fast lap reads as a spinner). Mood: calm, techy. Sections: hero. Cost: light, mobile risk low. Pairs with: 3d-tilt-hover. File: `patterns/orbit-animation/pattern.md`
- **Focus-trapped modal** `focus-trap-modal` (overlay). Use when: A short task must be finished or dismissed before going back, such as confirming a delete or a two-field form. Avoid when: Long forms, content people want to compare with the page, or anything that could be its own page or an inline message. Mood: focused. Sections: dialog. Cost: light, mobile risk low. Pairs with: combobox. File: `patterns/focus-trap-modal/pattern.md`
- **Combobox** `combobox` (input). Use when: Picking one value from a long list (more than about 10 options) where typing is faster than scrolling. Avoid when: Short lists (use radio buttons or a native select), or free text that is not a choice from a list. Mood: focused. Sections: form, search. Cost: light, mobile risk medium. Pairs with: focus-trap-modal. File: `patterns/combobox/pattern.md`
- **Command palette** `command-palette` (navigation). Use when: An app or docs site with many actions or pages that keyboard users jump between. Avoid when: Simple marketing pages, or as the only way to reach something (it must not hide features). Mood: techy, focused. Sections: app, docs. Cost: light, mobile risk medium. File: `patterns/command-palette/pattern.md`

## Concepts

- `ambient-motion`: Motion that runs on its own, without the visitor doing anything. File: `concepts/ambient-motion.md`
- `aria-activedescendant`: Keep focus in a text field while arrow keys move through a list, and still tell screen readers which item is active. File: `concepts/aria-activedescendant.md`
- `counter-rotation`: Spin a child the opposite way at the same speed, so it keeps its orientation while it travels. File: `concepts/counter-rotation.md`
- `css-custom-properties`: Variables in CSS. JavaScript sets the numbers, CSS decides how they look. File: `concepts/css-custom-properties.md`
- `css-keyframes`: Describe an animation's steps in CSS and let the browser run it. File: `concepts/css-keyframes.md`
- `custom-hook`: Put reusable stateful logic in a function that starts with "use", so any component can share it. File: `concepts/custom-hook.md`
- `decorative-aria-hidden`: Hide purely visual parts from screen readers, or describe the whole thing once. File: `concepts/decorative-aria-hidden.md`
- `focus-management`: Move focus on purpose when the page changes, and put it back when you are done. File: `concepts/focus-management.md`
- `global-shortcut`: A key combination that works anywhere on the page, such as Cmd+K. File: `concepts/global-shortcut.md`
- `keyboard-navigation`: Every interaction works without a mouse, using the keys people already expect. File: `concepts/keyboard-navigation.md`
- `live-region`: Tell screen reader users about a change they did not move to, such as "3 results". File: `concepts/live-region.md`
- `native-dialog`: The <dialog> element with showModal() gives you a real modal: top layer, inert background, Esc to close. File: `concepts/native-dialog.md`
- `pointer-events`: One set of events that covers mouse, pen and touch. File: `concepts/pointer-events.md`
- `reduced-motion`: Honor the operating system setting that asks for less movement, and ship a still version of every animation. File: `concepts/reduced-motion.md`
- `refs-over-state`: Write values that change every frame straight to the DOM through a ref, instead of re-rendering React. File: `concepts/refs-over-state.md`
- `requestanimationframe`: Run a function right before the next screen paint, so animation stays in step with the display. File: `concepts/requestanimationframe.md`
- `usesyncexternalstore-media-query`: Read a media query such as reduced motion in React with useSyncExternalStore, so it updates live. File: `concepts/usesyncexternalstore-media-query.md`
- `web-animations-api`: Control running CSS animations from JavaScript without restarting them. File: `concepts/web-animations-api.md`
